title: Perfect supported source and compatible map on an affine union
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U\subseteq W$ be opens with $W$ quasi-compact, and let $V$ be an affine open. Put $Y=W\cup V$. Let $T\subseteq X$ be closed with quasi-compact complement. Choose derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of modules on $X$, its localized open sites, $U$, its localized open sites, $Y$, and its localized open sites, all with Hom universe $w$. Let $E\in D_{QCoh}(\mathcal O_X)$, $R\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, and $\beta:R\to E$. Suppose $R$ has strictly perfect local models [def-pc-perfect-complex] at every point of $W$ and every cohomology stalk of $R$ vanishes on $W\setminus T$. Let $L:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and $J:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_U)$ be exact restriction followed by Modules.overEquiv. Let $H:D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D(\mathcal O_U)$ be induced by the inverse over-equivalence at $Y$, overMap for $U\subseteq Y$, and the over-equivalence at $U$. For every natural isomorphism $c:H\circ L\cong J$, there exist a perfect object $F\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$, a map $\alpha:F\to L(E)$, and an isomorphism $e:H(F)\cong J(R)\oplus J(R)[1]$. All cohomology stalks of $F$ vanish at $y\in Y$ with $y\notin T$, and $c_E\circ H(\alpha)=J(\beta)\circ\mathrm{pr}_1\circ e$. The conclusion is on $Y$ only; no ambient representative on $X$ is supplied.

source.place: Tag 09IM, two-open paragraph beginning with the supported extension Q and ending with the glued perfect supported source; Tags 08EK, 08EH and 08DG

proof.text: Use the local derived category transport [lem-pc-open-derived-localization-adjunction] on W, V and their intersection. Restrict the given strictly perfect models to W, transporting bounded terms and their finite-free retract data through Modules.overEquiv. Exact restriction preserves the cohomology stalks and therefore the support condition. Restriction of E has quasi-coherent cohomology by [lem-pc-derived-open-restriction-qcoh-iff].

Quasi-separatedness makes W intersect V compact and makes V intersect the open complement of T compact, by IsCompact.inter_of_isOpen. Closedness pulls back to V. Apply [lem-sc-affine-perfect-support-extension] on V to R restricted to W intersect V. It gives a supported perfect source restricting to the stabilization of R on the overlap. Compose the overlap isomorphism with first projection and the restricted beta.

Apply [lem-sc-affine-perfect-map-lift] to this overlap map on V. Replace the affine source by its perfect tensor augmentation, which is invertible on the overlap, and use its support-preservation assertion with T intersect V. Its lifted map and the first-projection map on W agree on W intersect V by the lifting equation.

Apply [lem-sc-derived-open-gluing] on the two-open cover of Y. Obtain F and alpha with the stated restrictions to W and V. At every point choose the strictly perfect model on one member of the cover; transport along the gluing isomorphism. The same local identifications give vanishing of cohomology stalks outside T. Restrict the W identification to U and compose the canonical biproduct and shift comparisons, giving e0 and the map equation with the canonical restriction comparison k. For a supplied c, put t = k.symm followed by c, a natural automorphism of J. Define e by postcomposing e0 with the biproduct of t at R and the shift of t at R. Its first projection is the first projection of e0 followed by t at R. Naturality of t on beta gives the displayed equation with c. No compatibility of c with shifts is assumed. This argument makes no extension to X.

theorem exists_supported_map_affine_union_gluing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U W V : X.Opens) (hUW : U ≤ W) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X))
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ O : (W ⊔ V).toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (W ⊔ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace).over O))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (R : schemeDerivedCategory X) (β : R ⟶ E.obj)
    (hR : (∀ x : X, x ∈ W → ∃ O : X.Opens, x ∈ O ∧
        ∃ K : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over O)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect X O K ∧
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
            (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) O).mapDerivedCategory.obj R ≅
              DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)))
    (hRT : (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∈ W → x ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj R).val.presheaf x)))) :
    let Y := W ⊔ V
    let L := SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) Y ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over Y))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv Y)
    let H := Equivalence.inverse
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over Y))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv Y) ⋙
      SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (le_trans hUW le_sup_left)) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)
    let J := SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)
    ∀ c : L.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ H.mapDerivedCategory ≅ J.mapDerivedCategory,
    ∃ (F : schemeDerivedCategory Y.toScheme) (α : F ⟶ L.mapDerivedCategory.obj E.obj),
      IsPerfect Y.toScheme F ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : Y.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj F).val.presheaf x))) ∧
      ∃ e : H.mapDerivedCategory.obj F ≅
          J.mapDerivedCategory.obj R ⊞ (J.mapDerivedCategory.obj R)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
        H.mapDerivedCategory.map α ≫ c.hom.app E.obj =
          e.hom ≫ biprod.fst ≫ J.mapDerivedCategory.map β
